csv_scope_of_work: Johnson County seeks to establish a pool of qualified engineering firms to provide professional engineering services on an as-needed basis for various County projects. Services shall be provided under an Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) arrangement to support Johnson County departments, including Public Works and other County operations. The County is seeking firms capable of providing comprehensive engineering support services across multiple engineering disciplines. Respondents are encouraged to provide or coordinate all required disciplines either through in-house staff or qualified subconsultants.
